en.sense_definition: An abnormal immune reaction by the body to normally harmless substances such as pollen, foods, or dust.

falsification.example_en: People with a severe peanut allergy should always carry an emergency auto-injector.
falsification.example_ja: 重度のピーナッツアレルギーを持つ人は常に緊急用自己注射器を携帯すべきです。
falsification.example_vi: Người bị dị ứng lạc nghiêm trọng nên luôn mang theo bút tiêm tự động khẩn cấp.
falsification.why_distinct: No allergy or allergic reaction concept exists in the canonical graph.

note: Sense: abnormal immune hypersensitivity. JMdict 1019740 s0 gloss allergy, pri 3. VI dị ứng in vn_freq rank 2855. Rework: replaced regional đậu phộng with neutral lạc (vn_freq rank 1574) and calque ống tiêm tự động biểu bì with medical bút tiêm tự động.

en.sense_definition: A medical specialty and hospital department dealing with the non-surgical treatment of adult diseases.

falsification.example_en: The clinic referred the patient to internal medicine for persistent abdominal distress.
falsification.example_ja: 診療所は長引く腹部の不快感について患者を内科に紹介した。
falsification.example_vi: Phòng khám đã chuyển bệnh nhân đến khoa nội vì các cơn đau bụng dai dẳng.
falsification.why_distinct: No hospital internal medicine department or specialty concept exists in the canonical graph.

note: Sense: medical specialty and hospital department for adult diseases. JMdict 1457830 s0 gloss internal medicine, pri 3. VI khoa nội is the standard hospital department name matching the slot topic; replaced awkward tautology khoa nội khoa. Unlisted in unigram vn_freq, ceiling MEDIUM.

en.sense_definition: The branch of medicine and hospital department that specializes in the medical care of children.

falsification.example_en: She completed her medical residency in pediatrics to care for sick children.
falsification.example_ja: 彼女は病気の子供たちを治療するため小児科で研修を修了した。
falsification.example_vi: Cô ấy đã hoàn thành khóa thực tập tại khoa nhi để chăm sóc trẻ em bị bệnh.
falsification.why_distinct: No pediatrics or children medicine department concept exists in the canonical corpus.

note: Sense: medical specialty and hospital department treating infants and children. JMdict 1348200 s0 gloss pediatrics, pri 3. VI khoa nhi is the official hospital department name matching the slot topic; replaced awkward tại khoa nhi khoa. Not in unigram vn_freq, ceiling MEDIUM.

en.sense_definition: The induced loss of physical sensation or consciousness to prevent pain during medical operations.

falsification.example_en: The doctor administered general anesthesia to ensure the patient remained asleep throughout surgery.
falsification.example_ja: 医師は手術中に患者が眠り続けるよう全身麻酔を施した。
falsification.example_vi: Bác sĩ đã tiến hành gây mê toàn thân để đảm bảo bệnh nhân ngủ say suốt ca phẫu thuật.
falsification.why_distinct: No anesthesia, sedation, or loss of sensation concept exists in the canonical graph.

note: Sense: induced loss of sensation/consciousness for surgery. JMdict 1603940 s0 gloss anesthesia, pri 3. VI gây mê in vn_freq rank 6197. Review feedback noted gây mê strictly denotes general anesthesia vs local gây tê. Lowered confidence to MEDIUM to reflect partial lexical asymmetry; examples aligned to surgical sedation.

en.sense_definition: The monetary price charged to visitors for entry into a cultural site, museum, or venue.

falsification.example_en: Visitors must pay an admission fee at the entrance of the national art museum.
falsification.example_ja: 来館者は国立美術館の入口で入場料を支払わなければならない。
falsification.example_vi: Du khách phải trả phí vào cửa tại lối vào của bảo tàng nghệ thuật quốc gia.
falsification.why_distinct: No admission fee or entrance fee concept exists in the canonical graph.
